StateTree.Comment: Grinding subtree for Mage bots on their own (run by STAI_NonCombat_Autonomous_Mage.xml): pulls the closest safe unit of a fitting level, else walks to a spawn point of such units; the fight is the Combat tree's

Task.Comment: what to hunt: pullTarget (closest safe unit of a fitting level), huntLocation (a spawn point of such units further away), onPullTarget

Task.name: Pull Range
Task.Comment: movement goal: in spell range and sight of the unit to pull

Task.name: Hunt Area
Task.Comment: movement goal: to the next spawn point while there is nothing to pull

State.name: Pull
State.Comment: the opener: once it is cast the unit fights the bot and the Combat tree takes over

State.name: Search
State.Comment: walking to the unit or the hunt location: Pull once the Pull Range goal arrives; selects again every second (a failed Pull, or an arrival before this state started, fires no delegate)
